crossRefs.note: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer…
With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward…
Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.
Leah said, “Happy am I, for the daughters will call me happy.” She named him Asher.
Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of…
Their border was to Jezreel, Chesulloth, Shunem,

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Benjamin
people.line: Youngest son of Jacob and Rachel

people.name: Ephraim
people.line: Second son of Joseph, and a tribe of Israel.

people.name: Gilead
people.line: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jezreel
people.line: A city in Issachar, associated with Ahab and Jezebel

translations.web: and he made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Ephraim, and over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
translations.bsb: and made him king over Gilead, Asher, Jezreel, Ephraim, and Benjamin—over all Israel.
